# Texan4America

> Texan4America: a blog and podcast on faith, family, and freedom from a native Texan. Coming soon.

Faith · Family · Freedom

Plain talk from a native Texan, husband, and father, on the faith that grounds us, the families that build us, and the freedoms that make America worth defending.

Blog & Podcast: Coming Soon.
